title: Booking document status (booking_documents.status)
caption: src/documents/documents.processor.ts and documents.repository.ts: no pending rows are written (a document without a row is not ready yet); a new ready version supersedes the older ones; a failed row supersedes nothing, so the last ready version stays downloadable.

states.label: document.render queued
states.detail: On booking.created, booking.ticketed, booking.schedule_changed, booking.cancelled, … (kind, bookingVersion).

states.label: ready
states.detail: PDF stored at `storage_key` (tenant_<key>/…), `content_hash` SHA-256, downloadable through a signed URL.

states.label: failed
states.detail: Renderer, storage or DB error: nothing stored, `size_bytes` null; BullMQ retries (5 attempts).

states.label: superseded
states.detail: An older version replaced by a newer ready one.
